entities.summary: Buyunchaokete, known as Bu Yunchaokete, is a Chinese tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 64, achieved on 14 April 2025 and a doubles ranking of No. 274, achieved on 23 October 2023. He is currently the No. 1 male player from China.
